ValidationRule.description: If the dispute reason is 'Cardholder does not recognize transaction' then 'Is Card Lost/Stolen' cannot be NA or empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Cardholder does not recognise transaction'), OR( ISPICKVAL( Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c ,'NA'), ISPICKVAL( Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c ,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this dispute reason, please select either No, Lost, Stolen for this field.
